name: subastasventura.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.
lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.
summary: subastasventura.com scores 76 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 27 pass. Fix first: 6 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 6 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /vin, /proveedores, /intranet. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 5 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: <html> element must have a lang attribute
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /vin, /proveedores, for example html. Impact: serious.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 5 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4, Universal Analytics appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 4 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /vin, /proveedores, /intranet, /noticias-main. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 352 ms
